prompts.prompt: Create ONE isolated transparent-background pixel-art eight-way virtual joystick for a Chinese wuxia fighting game. This is a fresh redesign; use the reference only for navy/ivory/turquoise palette and crisp pixels. The previous thick golden disc is rejected. Much lighter, restrained and elegant: a SMALL dark navy central thumb disc, a tiny turquoise center dot, and eight small ivory directional ARROW glyphs evenly spaced at 45-degree angles around it, including clearly readable diagonal arrows ↖ ↗ ↙ ↘. Each arrow is a clean thin two-native-pixel bent arrow with a stem and sharp V-shaped head, NOT a large solid triangle. Provide a tiny dark navy outline under the arrows so they remain readable on busy backgrounds. NO large outer disc or filled panel; most of the space between center and arrows is transparent. At most a few subtle muted bronze accent pixels on the central disc, no gold outer rim, no thick bevel, no ornamental scrollwork, no heavy shadow. Visually balanced, symmetric, compact. Conceptual native sprite size 64x64, enlarged by integer pixels on square canvas with actual alpha transparency around and between the elements. Exactly eight directions plus one center, no letters, no text, no numbers, no extra controls. Crisp uniform pixel art; no blur or antialiasing.

Standalone 2D fighting-game stage background for Ash Harbor, original Chinese wuxia world. Aspect ratio 32:19, intended native raster 512x304, suggested delivery 1536x912. Strict crisp 1990s arcade pixel art, limited clustered color shading, equally sized square pixels throughout, no smooth painting, no anti-aliasing. Match reference's pixel density and strong layer depth. Fixed side-on game camera, level ground, no tilt. An uninterrupted flat fighting platform of paving spans the full width of the BOTTOM 30% of the canvas; its top edge stays horizontal at 70% image height, the character foot-contact line is at 84% image height, keep that lower region free of props, barriers, stairs, holes or water. Put detailed scenery behind that platform, with a clear uncluttered central band for two full-body fighters. Do not include characters, text, logos, UI, split panels, frames, modern objects, electricity poles, engines, chimneys, iron/steel ships, steamships, cranes, firearms, or industrial equipment. All architecture and vessels must be traditional Chinese wooden construction. Scene: a rain-soaked Chinese harbor at deep moonlit night. Replace ALL modern shipping with traditional large WOODEN CHINESE JUNK sailing vessels: curved high wooden sterns and prominent fan-shaped battened sails, rigging and warm lanterns. No smokestacks. A mysterious dark-sailed junk approaches in the middle-right background, smaller wooden fishing junks further back. Red lantern-lit timber pavilions and a low stone embankment to the left, an ancient hill fortress behind, a warm gold moon through blue storm clouds, rain and teal water reflecting lantern light. Foreground continuous wet dark-gray stone quay, level paving from 70% height downwards, open across the entire width. Navy, teal and ember gold palette. Preserve the rainy harbor atmosphere of the reference while making the era unambiguously historical Chinese wuxia.
